newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Chilenger buys Colombia's Chivor power plant.
newsitem.headline: Chilenger buys Colombia's Chivor power plant.

text.p: A subsidiary of the Chilean company Chilenger bought Colombia's 1,000 megawatt Chivor hydro-electric generator, government officials said Friday.
The Chilean concern paid 644.5 billion pesos for the plant, the Colombian official said.

The purchase, conducted by sealed bids, was announced the day after the government revealed the winning bids for the 499 megawatt Betania hydro-electric plant, purchased by Endesa- Colombia also of Chile, and a 14.25 percent stake in the 193 megawatt gas and oil-fired Termocartagena plant, bought by venezuela's Electricidad de Caracas.
The government is due to announce the winning bids for two other power plants Ocoa and Guandalay y Yumbo later Friday.

"We're very proud to announce that these two Chilean companies have teamed up with Colombia to provide generating services," Finance Minister Jos Antonio Ocampo told reporters at the event to announce the winning bids.
